question: In the Six Faces of Death adventure, what is Cube 1717, who controls it, and why can't creatures escape the island by teleportation?
expected_answer: Cube 1717 is an Acheronian cube (from the plane of Acheron). It is controlled by Vargo, a skull lord who took power from the rightful ruler, Earl Andromalius. The cube's infernal magic prevents creatures from leaving the island by teleportation without the permission of the cube's ruler, Earl Andromalius — but this permission cannot be granted because Andromalius is dead.

bm25_free_haiku.answer: Cube 1717 is a 600-ft cubical battle station from Acheron, designed by derro architect Avnas, originally ruled by Earl Andromalius. Controlled by Vargo, a skull lord using the Six-Face Throne. Teleportation blocked because 'the cube's infernal magic prevents creatures from leaving without permission of Earl Andromalius—which cannot be granted, as Andromalius is dead.' Restriction ends only if Heart Engine (area 6.28) is destroyed. Source: DRA21_sixfacesdeath.pdf p.1-3, 8-9.

quality.notes: All elements correct with extensive bonus detail: cube dimensions, architect, Six-Face Throne mechanism, Heart Engine escape condition. Verbatim quote of the teleportation restriction.
